explanation_full: The feature ranking analysis indicates that VFA is the most important feature, scoring 0.7931, followed closely by Butyrate (0.7902) and Acetate (0.7772). In terms of model performance, the KNN model achieved the best results on the test set, reporting an R² of 0.81717 and an MSE of 0.012810. Furthermore, the incremental feature analysis shows that adding 11 features resulted in the highest KNN score of 0.817859, suggesting that a comprehensive set of features is beneficial for model performance.
